$comment: Dated aliases of sf-admin-menu for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). sf-admin-menu-intent splits into one event per verb (vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.1): each row sends the old name after its new one, with the old detail {intent, payload} the element's adapter makes. compact-change, settings-cancel, settings-mode-change, settings-refresh, settings-save and navigate keep their DOM names.
